title: Smart Stuff with Justin and Roman- Founder Effect

sentences.en: In August of 2016, Justin McElroy and I created the next great leap forward in podcasting,

sentences.en: It all started on My Brother, My Brother and Me, episode number 316.

sentences.en: I am your host, Justin McElroy.
sentences.zh: 我是你们的主持人，贾斯汀·麦克尔罗伊。

sentences.en: I'm joined as always today by Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 今天和我一起主持的依然是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Hey, Justin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，贾斯汀。

sentences.en: Roman, what smart thing are we discussing today?
sentences.zh: 罗曼，我们今天讨论什么聪明的话题？

sentences.en: Well, for episode two of the Smart Stuff Podcast,
sentences.zh: 嗯，在《聪明玩意儿》播客的第二期节目中，

sentences.en: I'd like to talk about one of my favorite things in population genetics,
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈我在群体遗传学中最喜欢的话题之一，

sentences.en: the founder effect.
sentences.zh: 奠基者效应。

sentences.en: The founder effect is when there's a loss of genetic variation in a new population
sentences.zh: 奠基者效应是指在一个新种群中，遗传变异的丧失，

sentences.en: because it was started by a small number of founders from a larger population.
sentences.zh: 因为它是从一个更大的种群中由少数几个奠基者开始的。

sentences.en: Now, did it?
sentences.zh: 那么，它做到了吗？

sentences.en: Think of it like this.
sentences.zh: 可以这样想。

sentences.en: According to the 2010 U.S.
sentences.zh: 根据2010年美国

sentences.en: Census, the United States is 72.4% white,
sentences.zh: 人口普查，美国白人占72.4%，

sentences.en: 16.3% Hispanic or Latino, 12.6% black, and 4.8% Asian.
sentences.zh: 西班牙裔或拉丁裔占16.3%，黑人占12.6%，亚裔占4.8%。

sentences.en: That's the average across all of America.
sentences.zh: 这是全美国的平均水平。

sentences.en: But imagine that one city in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但想象一下，美国有一个城市

sentences.en: wanted to start a colony on Mars.
sentences.zh: 想要在火星上建立一个殖民地。

sentences.en: Speak on that.
sentences.zh: 说说看。

sentences.en: That city may not have those proportions or that degree of genetic variation.
sentences.zh: 那个城市可能并不具备这些比例或那种程度的遗传变异。

sentences.en: So, for example, the widest city in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 比如，美国最宽的城市，

sentences.en: is Scottsdale, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 是亚利桑那州的斯科茨代尔。

sentences.en: It's about 90% white.
sentences.zh: 那里约90%的人口是白人。

sentences.en: If Scottsdalians broke off to form their own Martian colony,
sentences.zh: 如果斯科茨代尔人脱离出来，去建立自己的火星殖民地，

sentences.en: even though Scottsdale is a population within the United States,
sentences.zh: 尽管斯科茨代尔本身也是美国的一个人口群体，

sentences.en: that colony would have much less genetic diversity than the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但那个殖民地的遗传多样性将远低于整个美国，

sentences.en: population as a whole.
sentences.zh: 人口整体的遗传多样性。

sentences.en: Usually founding populations are much smaller than entire cities.
sentences.zh: 通常，创始种群的规模要比整个城市小得多。

sentences.en: So imagine there was only two individuals that started a new population,
sentences.zh: 所以想象一下，如果只有两个人开启了一个新种群，

sentences.en: and then the genes those two individuals carried would be the only genetic variation
sentences.zh: 那么这两个人所携带的基因，将是整个基因库中，

sentences.en: in the entire gene pool.
sentences.zh: 仅有的遗传变异。

sentences.en: Subsequent generations may introduce some random mutations,
sentences.zh: 后续世代可能会引入一些随机突变，

sentences.en: but otherwise, that's it.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，也就这些了。

sentences.en: That's all you're working with.
sentences.zh: 这就是你所能利用的全部基因。

sentences.en: When it comes to plants and animals and bacteria,
sentences.zh: 当谈到植物、动物和细菌时，

sentences.en: an isolated founding population with low genetic diversity
sentences.zh: 一个遗传多样性较低的孤立创始种群，

sentences.en: that by chance had different genetic makeup than the population it came from
sentences.zh: 如果碰巧拥有与原种群不同的基因构成，

sentences.en: could lead that new population to becoming a whole new species given enough time.
sentences.zh: 在足够长的时间下，可能会导致该新种群演化成一个全新的物种。

sentences.en: But wait, wouldn't that...
sentences.zh: 等等，难道不会……

sentences.en: Now, if the small number of founders of a population have a genetic mutation,
sentences.zh: 现在，如果一个种群的少数创始者携带某种基因突变，

sentences.en: and the new population remains somewhat isolated,
sentences.zh: 且这个新种群在某种程度上保持孤立，

sentences.en: that mutation will be much more common, even as the population grows over time.
sentences.zh: 那么随着时间的推移，即使种群规模扩大，这种突变也会变得更加普遍。

sentences.en: Oh, I see.
sentences.zh: 哦，我明白了。

sentences.en: So, in the 18th century, about 200 families founded the Amish population of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 所以，在18世纪，大约200个家庭创立了宾夕法尼亚州的阿米什人种群。

sentences.en: And at least one of those families had a mutation called polydactyly.
sentences.zh: 而这些家庭中至少有一个携带了多指症突变。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: And even today, the Pennsylvania Amish have much higher rates of polydactyly
sentences.zh: 即使在今天，宾夕法尼亚阿米什人的多指症发病率，

sentences.en: than the U.S.
sentences.zh: 也远高于美国，

sentences.en: population as a whole.
sentences.zh: 整体人口的发病率。

sentences.en: And that's why, even though it's still quite rare,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，尽管它仍然非常罕见，

sentences.en: an Amish person is much more likely to have 11 fingers.
sentences.zh: 但阿米什人长出11根手指的可能性要大得多。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: It doesn't usually look like a fully formed finger.
sentences.zh: 它通常看起来不像一根发育完全的手指。

sentences.en: It's often just a little nub.
sentences.zh: 往往只是一个小肉赘。

sentences.en: Well, folks, that's all we have time for on Smart Stuff today.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，今天《Smart Stuff》节目的时间就到这里了。

sentences.en: This kind of groundbreaking work made by pioneers in the world of podcasting
sentences.zh: 这种由播客界的先驱们所创造的开创性工作，

sentences.en: is only possible because of listener support.
sentences.zh: 只有在听众的支持下才有可能实现。

sentences.en: Right now, if you go to radiotopia.fm,
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你访问 radiotopia.fm，

sentences.en: you'll find a big button that says Roman Mars' Beautiful Nerd Brigade.
sentences.zh: 你会看到一个大按钮，上面写着“Roman Mars的美丽书呆子旅团”。

sentences.en: If you click it, you'll be donating $10.
sentences.zh: 如果你点击它，你将捐赠10美元。

sentences.en: And you'll get an invitation to the online version of my office hours,
sentences.zh: 你还会收到一份邀请，参加我在线的“办公时间”活动，

sentences.en: where I will impart onto you and a bunch of other beautiful nerds
sentences.zh: 届时我将向你和其他一群可爱的书呆子们，

sentences.en: all the things I've learned about podcasting in the last 10-plus years.
sentences.zh: 传授我在过去十多年里学到的关于播客的一切知识。

sentences.en: Clearly, as evidenced by Smart Stuff,
sentences.zh: 显然，正如《Smart Stuff》所证明的那样，

sentences.en: I have a lot of knowledge about podcasting to impart onto you.
sentences.zh: 我有很多关于播客的知识可以传授给你们。

sentences.zh: 在Radiotopia的听众中，大约每1万人里有8人会捐款。

sentences.en: That means very likely you are one of the 9,992 who do not.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你很有可能就是那9992名没有捐款的人之一。

sentences.en: But you can change that.
sentences.zh: 但你可以改变这一点。

sentences.en: Go to radiotopia.fm,
sentences.zh: 访问 radiotopia.fm，

sentences.en: click the Roman Mars Beautiful Nerd Brigade button,
sentences.zh: 点击“Roman Mars的美丽书呆子旅团”按钮，

sentences.en: and a big group of us will hang out and talk about podcasting.
sentences.zh: 我们一大群人将会聚在一起聊聊播客。

sentences.en: It's going to be awesome.
sentences.zh: 那一定会很棒。

sentences.en: We need 35,000 people to be backers to this drive to hit our goal.
sentences.zh: 我们需要3.5万人成为这次活动的赞助者才能达到目标。

sentences.en: Let's reach that goal together.
sentences.zh: 让我们一起实现这个目标吧。

sentences.en: We've made it really, really easy.
sentences.zh: 我们让捐款变得非常、非常简单。

sentences.en: 10 bucks, that's it.
sentences.zh: 10美元，仅此而已。

sentences.en: You're in the brigade.
sentences.zh: 你就加入了旅团。

sentences.en: And when you're done,
sentences.zh: 当你完成后，

sentences.en: send me a note about it on Twitter at Roman Mars,
sentences.zh: 在Twitter上发条消息给我，@Roman Mars，

sentences.en: and I will thank you personally.
sentences.zh: 我会亲自感谢你。

sentences.en: That's radiotopia.fm.
sentences.zh: 网址是 radiotopia.fm。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: What a fascinating tale.
sentences.zh: 真是个引人入胜的故事。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。
